roads.name: Lighthouse Road
words: An easygoing road: 7 curves in 4.0 miles, with room to breathe between them.
From 6 to 17 ft, with 31 ft of up and down along the way.
Wooded nearly the whole way.
July highs average 92°F.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every sweeper in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 35 mph limit its curves ask for about 0.22 g.
